claims.quote: Israel's renewables share went from 1.9% in 2015
claims.sql: SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015
SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025
SELECT coal_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2015
SELECT coal_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025

claims.quote: The coal phase-out was driven mainly by the growth of solar.
claims.note: The 42 percentage point decline in coal far exceeds the 15 percentage point increase in renewables/solar, meaning solar could not have been the main driver of the phase-out.

claims.quote: Total generation grew by 17.9% between 2015 and 2025
claims.sql: SELECT 100.0 * (e2025.electricity_generation - e2015.electricity_generation) / e2015.electricity_generation FROM energy e2015 JOIN energy e2025 ON e2015.country = e2025.country WHERE e2015.country = 'Israel' AND e2015.year = 2015 AND e2025.year = 2025
SELECT electricity_generation FROM energy WHERE country = 'Israel' AND year = 2025
SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Greece' AND year = 2025
SELECT renewables_share_elec FROM energy WHERE country = 'Cyprus' AND year = 2025

claims.quote: Greece (49.7%) and Cyprus (27.8%) are well ahead on renewables in 2025
claims.note: Both Greece (49.7%) and Cyprus (27.8%) have higher renewable shares than Israel's 16.9% in 2025.

requirements.evidence: Israel's renewables share went from 1.9% in 2015 to 16.9% in 2025.

requirements.evidence: Coal fell from 45.4% to 3.4% over the same period.
